name: tpl-existence-1-nogoal
task: Flip the switch on the wall.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Flip the switch on the wall' is an unconditional command with no preference cue, so one hard Existence(switch_toggled) states exactly that goal. switch_toggled is the toggle event of the wall switch, which the agent can toggle from the floor cell beside it. The switch exists only in setups with a siren, but the task presupposes it, so no clause could do better there.

texts: The agent toggles the wall switch at least once during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled, u1) -> 11
